source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: ISC Class XI school final (annual) examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Final Examination - 2017-2018', 'CHEMISTRY', 'Std. : XI', 'Time : 3 hrs. + 15 min.', 'F. M. : 80'; examYear 2018 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). durationMinutes 195 = 3 h + 15 min as printed. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images. The instructions print: 'Question 1 is of 20 marks which is compulsory. Question 2 to 8 carry 2 marks each. Question 9 to 15 carry 3 marks each and question 16 to 18 carry 5 marks each'; Part II marks are taken from these instructions. These add up to 70, not the printed F.M. 80. Q1 is split into its printed sub-parts; Q2-Q18 are kept whole (their a/b sub-parts share the question's marks). Q2, Q6, Q10, Q11, Q16, Q17 and Q18 have internal OR choices (alternatives labelled (a)/(b) by the editor). Q11 is printed as 'II.'. Chemical subscripts, charges and arrows were rebuilt from the page images as Unicode; benzene-ring structures in Q17 are not reproduced. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
